why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: 1 Step 1 : Add the Chrome extension or run the desktop installer Go to the Bless homepage and pick either the browser extension or the desktop installer to set Bless up.
2 Step 2 : Choose whether to allow data collection Collection of your data is opt-in. Turning it down means Bless collects nothing.
3 Step 3 : Stay online with a steady connection Keep your internet connection stable, the one requirement the homepage lists. Bless then matches your idle device with suitable computing tasks.
4 Step 4 : Leave Bless running to build uptime Your online time keeps adding up while Bless runs. Referrals and achievements can bring bonus rewards.
